title: curated severity/progression literature pass, round 4 (PMC-OA dominant-sequela join) — severity lift that order-locks Duchenne muscular dystrophy

litcurate4_join.exact_sentence: Introduction Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is a severe, progressive neuromuscular disorder characterized by the gradual deterioration and weakening of skeletal and cardiac muscle tissue [ 1 ].

Background/Objectives : Tyrosinemia type 1 (HT-1) is a treatable inherited disorder characterized by disrupted tyrosine metabolism, leading to severe liver, renal, and occasionally neurological dysfunction.

litcurate4_excluded.considered_statement: The severe phenotype is known as Hurler syndrome (MPS IH; OMIM 607014 ), and other forms are classified as attenuated MPS I (Hurler-Scheie syndrome, MPS IH-S, OMIM 607015 ; Scheie syndrome, MPS IS, OMIM 607016 ).
litcurate4_excluded.exclusion_reason: the retrievable OA disease-level severity framing for Hurler syndrome (C0086795) is COMPARATIVE -- it defines Hurler AS 'the severe phenotype' of mucopolysaccharidosis type I in explicit contrast to the 'attenuated' forms (Hurler-Scheie, Scheie); although the frozen R3 severity function pattern-matches 'severe', the word is the phenotype-class label distinguishing Hurler from the milder MPS I forms (severe-vs-attenuated within the MPS I spectrum), not a clean disease-level magnitude for Hurler's own dominant untreated sequela; the only other retrievable 'severe' magnitude in the dedicated MPS I-H burden paper ('Severe manifestations can include organ failure, cognitive impairments, and shortened lifespan') is a property of the MPS DISORDER CLASS generally, not Hurler specifically; S left [H], not lifted

litcurate4_excluded.considered_statement: Unlike thalassemia silent and minor which typically are asymptomatic, individuals with thalassemia intermedia present different levels of anemia at infancy, while patients with α-thalassemia major die in utero or shortly after birth, and patients with β-thalassemia major suffer from severe anemia and need lifelong transfusions and oral iron chelation therapy [ 3 , 5 , 6 ].
litcurate4_excluded.exclusion_reason: the retrievable OA severity framing for the beta-thalassemia umbrella entity (CN322236) is an UMBRELLA SPECTRUM that ranges from asymptomatic (thalassemia silent and minor) through thalassemia intermedia to transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia major ('severe anemia ... lifelong transfusions'); the disease-level magnitude is genotype/form-stratified across the silent-to-major continuum, and the 'severe' magnitude is explicitly attached to the MAJOR form, not to the umbrella entity's own single dominant sequela; the frozen R3 spectrum override trips on this within-entity range, so a clean disease-level umbrella severity tier is not defensibly isolable; S left [H], not lifted
